lines.text: The LORD tells Israel not to learn the ways of the nations, whose idols are cut from a tree and fastened with hammer and nails.
Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, the idols cannot speak, and they must be carried because they cannot walk.
Hammered silver is brought from Damascus, and gold from Uphaz, the work of a craftsman and a goldsmith.
The LORD made the earth by His power, and when He thunders, the mountains of the earth roar.
The Portion of Jacob is not like these idols, for He is the Maker of all things.
